Survival basics

How do Sleeping Bags and Beds (respawn points) work, how many can I place, and can I rename them?

You can now give each Sleeping Bag or Bed its own custom name - easy to tell respawn points apart across bases and react instantly during raids

Sleeping Bags and Beds are your personal respawn points. Place them wherever you need - and respawn at one of them.

  • You can have up to 10 respawn points. Placing an 11th automatically removes your oldest.

  • After you respawn at a point, it goes on a cooldown, points placed close together share that cooldown, so stacking many in one spot won't let you respawn instantly.

  • You can only respawn if the spot is clear - if it's blocked, you respawn normally instead.

  • You can give each Sleeping Bag or Bed its own custom name, so it's easy to tell your respawn points apart and react instantly during raids.

  • Respawn points belong to you.
